## Release — backlog-campaign v0.37.0

### ✨ What's new in v0.37.0

#### Features

- feat(pareto): re-score on dependency and linked-PR change (#1520 part 2) ([#1574](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1574))

#### Fixes

- fix(doc-index): make summary optional with H1 fallback ([#1502](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1502))
- fix(doc-gov): five-key V-DOC-GOV-02 row; keep literal trailing # in H1 fallback ([#1579](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1579))
- fix(hooks): resolve GIT_TRACE slots behind redirects, glued case labels and whole-command allexport mentions ([#1505](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1505))
- fix(hooks): keep a spaced ${...} word whole so it cannot hide the GIT_TRACE command slot ([#1582](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1582))

#### Other

- perf(implementer): load conditional gates on demand (slice 2b of #1387) ([#1568](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1568))
- perf(report): attribute worker transcripts to role and issue via .meta.json ([#1573](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1573))
- perf(planner): load track sections on demand by the spawn track directive (slice 6 of #1387) ([#1569](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1569))
- test(forge-sync): pin that reconcile keeps pareto.basis ([#1578](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1578))
- refactor(hooks): remove the worktree-removal guard and record the guard audit (ADR-061) ([#1508](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1508))
